//: Coverage floors for the frontend unit suite, enforced by scripts/check-coverage-thresholds.mjs. The global floor is low because it covers every component and route, most of which the unit suite does not exercise — it is a ratchet against regressions, not a statement about the app. The per-directory floors are where the suite actually does its work: formatting, stores, hooks and pure helpers, which is what a UI refactor breaks silently.
